clips.zh: 萌萌谈，你被投诉了，四百一十七次。
clips.action: Outside the same pet shop at night. Man kneels on RIGHT, one black cat LEFT. Start on the CAT, who raises its star badge and accuses the man deadpan. Slow push toward cat face. ONLY cat speaks; man mouth shut. The cat addresses the MAN by his proper name. Pronounce the first three syllables distinctly: MENG (second tone), MENG (second tone), TAN (second tone). MENG rhymes with English 'lung', not 'may'. Do not substitute 'Mei Qiu Tan'. Leave a tiny comma pause after the name. No additional animals entering, no scroll yet.

clips.zh: 煤球，精灵管理局稽查员。投诉单，拿好。
clips.en: Meiqiu, Spirit Bureau inspector. Your complaints. Take them.
clips.action: Outside same pet shop, man kneels RIGHT and black cat LEFT. Cat introduces ITSELF, name is MEI QIU (both second tones), then identifies its job, then decisively taps the ONE complaint scroll. As it says the last sentence, the paper unrolls forward along pavement. One yellow goggle duck and one white fluff behind cat, both silent. NO pigeon, no additional animals. ONLY cat speaks. Man reacts silently. Clear continuous shot; keep cat face visible for identity line.
